verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Arise my soul
Remember this
He took my sin
And He buried it

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
No longer I who live
Now Jesus lives in me
For I was dead in sin
But I woke up to see the light

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
No I won't boast
But in the cross
That saved my soul
All else is loss

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
The grip of fear
Has no hold on me
So where o death
Where is your sting?

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
All, all of this for your glory
All, all of this for your glory
